paite: TOUPA aw, ka thumna ngaikia inla ka kikou husa na kiang hong tung hen.
heading: TOUPA Mai A Thumna / Hihgim A Om, Tuailai Thumna
english: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before Yahweh. Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.

paite: Ka mangbat ni in ka lak ah na mai sel ke'nla, kei lam ah na bil hon doh in; ka hon sap chiang in hon dawng pah in.
english: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.

paite: Ka damsung nite meikhu bang in azammang a, ka guhte taptung bang in asa hi.
english: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.

paite: Ka lungtang loupa bang in hailum in a-om a, avuaita hi; tanghou nek ding ka mangngilhta ngal a.
english: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.

paite: Ka thum husa ziak in ka guhte kasa ah abelh bikbek ahi.
english: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.

paite: Gamdai tuivapi bang ka hi a; kho tul simbu bang ka hita hi.
english: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.

paite: Ka hak gige a, inn tung a kawlgit amah kia a om bang ka hita hi.
english: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.

paite: Hon doute'n nitum in hon gensia ua; ka tung a hangsante'n keimah bang a om ding in hamsia alou uhi.
english: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.

paite: Vut an bang in ka ne a, ka dawn ding in khitui toh ka helta ngal a.
english: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,

paite: Na lung hih louh mahmah leh na heh ziak in; nang na hon domkang a, na hon paimangta hi.
english: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.

paite: Ka damsung nite limliap kiam bang ahi a; loupa bang in ka vuaita hi.
english: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang bel tangtawn in na om ding a; nangmah theihgigena suan tengteng tan in a-om lai ding hi.
english: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.

paite: Na thou ding a, Zion tang na hehpih ding a; amah lah deihsak ahunta ngal a, ahi, hun seh atungta hi.
english: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.

paite: Na sikhate'n asuangte a-it un, aleivui leng ahehpih ngal uhi.
english: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.

paite: Huchi in namte'n TOUPA min alau ding ua, leitung a kumpipate tengteng in na thupina leng alau ding uhi.
english: So the nations will fear Yahweh’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.

paite: TOUPA'N Zion adinsak hun in, athupina in ahong kilang ding hi;
english: For Yahweh has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.

paite: Tagahte thumna alimsak a, athumna uh amusit kei hi.
english: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.

paite: Huai khangthak hong om dingte a ding in gelh ahi ding a, nam siam a hong om ding in TOUPA aphat ding hi.
english: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise Yah,

paite: Ama'n amun siangthou sangpi a kipan in a-ensuk a; TOUPA'N van a kipan in lei amu a;
english: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth,

paite: Suangkul tangte thumging ngaikhe ding leh, si ding a sehte khahkhe ding in;
english: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,

paite: Huchi a mite'n Zion ah TOUPA min agenthang ua, Jerusalem a aphatna agenthang theihna ding un.
english: that men may declare Yahweh’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,

paite: Mite akikhawmkhawm ua, kumpigamte toh, TOUPA nasem ding in.
english: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve Yahweh.

paite: Ama'n lam lak ah ka tha abahsak a; ka damsung ahihtom hi.
english: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.

paite: Ka Pathian aw, ka hat lai nite in hon lamang ke'n, ka chi a, nang kum suan om sung tengteng in a-om ding hi.
english: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.

paite: Leitung kingakna nidang a na phumsa ahi a; vante leng na khutsuak ahi.
english: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.

paite: Huaite tuh ahong mang ding a, nang zaw na omden ding hi; ahi, huai tengteng puansilh bang in ahong lui ding ua; puan bang in na khek ding a, ahong lamdangta ding hi.
english: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.

paite: Nang zaw na ngeingei a, na kumte'n bei ni anei kei ding.
english: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.

paite: Na sikhate tate a-om gige ding ua, asuante uh na ma ah hihkip in a-om ding uhi.
english: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”
